title: Financial Fraud
summary: For banking, card and UPI fraud, phishing and similar money loss.
whatToDoNow: Call 1930 immediately if a fraudulent transaction just happened.
Call your bank's official fraud number to block the card or freeze the account.
Do not share OTPs, PINs or passwords with anyone who contacts you, even if they claim to be from the bank.
If a SIM swap is suspected, contact your telecom operator and check Sanchar Saathi.
whoToContact: Your bank's fraud or dispute helpline
Your telecom operator, for SIM-related fraud
whereToReport: Sanchar Saathi, to check or block SIMs issued in your name
whatInformationToKeep: Account, card or loan numbers involved
Any SMS, email or app notification about the fraud
whatEvidenceToPreserve: Bank statements showing the disputed transactions
Screenshots of the fraudulent message, call log or website
Correspondence with your bank or telecom provider
